translation: The Clear Quran — Dr. Mustafa Khattab

verses.92:1: By the night when it covers
verses.92:2: and the day when it shines
verses.92:3: And by ˹the One˺ Who created male and female
verses.92:4: Surely the ends you strive for are diverse
verses.92:5: As for the one who is charitable, mindful ˹of Allah˺
verses.92:6: and ˹firmly˺ believes in the finest reward
verses.92:7: We will facilitate for them the Way of Ease
verses.92:8: And as for the one who is stingy, indifferent ˹to Allah˺
verses.92:10: We will facilitate for them the path of hardship
verses.92:11: And their wealth will be of no benefit to them when they tumble ˹into Hell˺
verses.92:12: It is certainly upon Us ˹alone˺ to show ˹the way to˺ guidance
verses.92:13: And surely to Us ˹alone˺ belong this life and the next
verses.92:14: And so I have warned you of a raging Fire
verses.92:15: in which none will burn except the most wretched—
verses.92:17: But the righteous will be spared from it—
verses.92:18: who donate ˹some of˺ their wealth only to purify themselves
verses.92:19: not in return for someone’s favours
verses.92:20: but seeking the pleasure of their Lord, the Most High
